items.label: Store Open / Closed
items.exampleValues: Whether the store is open or closed at the time — e.g. Open, Closed

items.label: Fixed Store Segments
items.exampleValues: e.g. Airport, Metro, Regional

items.label: Variable Store Segments
items.exampleValues: e.g. Cold Day, iPhone 17 – Out of Stock (switched on and off by store managers)

items.label: Display Tag(s)
items.exampleValues: e.g. Entrance, Checkout, Food Court

items.label: Suburb
items.exampleValues: e.g. Surry Hills, Parramatta

items.label: State
items.exampleValues: e.g. NSW, VIC, QLD

items.label: Country
items.exampleValues: e.g. Australia, New Zealand

items.label: Gender (Computer Vision)
items.exampleValues: Read by Vision/AI running at the edge, for the person in front of the display — e.g. Female, Male. Nothing leaves the store.

items.label: Estimated Age (Computer Vision)
items.exampleValues: Estimated by Vision/AI running at the edge, for the person in front of the display — e.g. 18–24, 25–34, 35–44. Nothing leaves the store.

items.label: Reason for Visit (Aggregate)
items.exampleValues: Everyone in the queue here right now, not one visitor: the share waiting for the same reason — e.g. Returns, New phone, Bill enquiry

items.label: Device Type (Aggregate)
items.exampleValues: Everyone in the store right now, not one visitor: the share carrying each device — e.g. iPhone, Pixel, Samsung

items.label: Age
items.exampleValues: The identified visitor’s age, from the systems that hold the customer record (CRM, CDP or loyalty) — e.g. 18–24, 25–34, 35–44

items.label: Gender
items.exampleValues: The identified visitor’s gender, from the systems that hold the customer record (CRM, CDP or loyalty) — e.g. Female, Male

items.label: Purchase Intent
items.exampleValues: e.g. Browse, Replenish, Gift

items.label: Visitor Segments
items.exampleValues: e.g. New parent, Fitness, Value seeker

items.label: Reason for Visit
items.exampleValues: Why the visitor in front of the screen is here, for that one person — e.g. Returns, New phone, Bill enquiry. The aggregate version above is the whole queue.

items.label: Device Type
items.exampleValues: The device the visitor in front of the screen is carrying — e.g. iPhone, Pixel, Samsung

items.label: Product Holdings
items.exampleValues: e.g. Mobile plan, Home broadband

items.label: Product Type
items.exampleValues: e.g. Handset, Accessory

items.label: Plan Type
items.exampleValues: e.g. Postpaid, Prepaid

items.label: Plan Value
items.exampleValues: e.g. $45, $65 per month

items.label: Purchase History
items.exampleValues: e.g. Bought in the last 30 days

items.label: Events
items.exampleValues: Events in store or from a previous web session — e.g. Scanned QR code, Viewed product page, Added to cart

items.label: SKUs
items.exampleValues: SKUs the visitor has looked at before; target by listing SKUs — e.g. SKU-10234, SKU-55871
